basic_info.description: Nestled in the heart of Visitacion Valley, this charming home offers versatile living spaces, stunning Bay views, and modern upgrades. The top floor features two bright bedrooms and a full bath, while the lower level includes an additional bedroom and bathideal for a guest suite or private office.    Designed for convenience and sustainability, the home includes solar panels, an electric car charger, and washer/dryer hookups in the garage. Located on a quiet street with easy parking, it also offers quick access to 101 & 280 freeways, Caltrain (Bayshore station), Muni T-line, and multiple bus lines, making it easy to explore San Francisco and beyond.    McLaren Park, with its hiking trails, sports courts, and the city's only ropes course, is just minutes away, along with the award-winning Visitacion Valley Greenway. A growing selection of local cafes, restaurants, and markets are nearby.    Enjoy breathtaking views of the San Bruno Mountains and the Bay, a welcoming neighborhood, and one of the sunniest climates in the cityall in a location that balances tranquility and connectivity.
